queries: WITH p AS (SELECT ID, AVG(PIC) AS avg_pic, AVG(HGB) * 1.0 / NULLIF(AVG(HCT), 0) AS ratio FROM Laboratory GROUP BY ID), o AS (SELECT AVG(ratio) AS overall_avg FROM p WHERE ratio IS NOT NULL) SELECT AVG(p.avg_pic) AS avg_of_avg_pic, AVG(p.ratio) AS avg_ratio, AVG(p.ratio - o.overall_avg) AS avg_excess FROM p CROSS JOIN o WHERE p.ratio > o.overall_avg;

assumptions.assumption: The all-patient average ratio is taken over patients who have a defined ratio, meaning at least one non-null HGB and one non-null nonzero-average HCT. Patients without a ratio are neither compared nor counted.
Patients whose average PIC is null (no PIC values) can still be kept if their ratio qualifies. They are skipped in the average of average PIC values.

responses.sql: WITH p AS (SELECT ID, AVG(PIC) AS avg_pic, AVG(HGB) * 1.0 / NULLIF(AVG(HCT), 0) AS ratio FROM Laboratory GROUP BY ID), g AS (SELECT AVG(ratio) AS avg_ratio FROM p) SELECT AVG(p.avg_pic) AS avg_of_avg_pic, AVG(p.ratio) AS avg_ratio, AVG(p.ratio - g.avg_ratio) AS avg_excess FROM p CROSS JOIN g WHERE p.ratio > g.avg_ratio

assumptions.assumption: The all-patient average is the unweighted mean of per-patient ratios, over patients whose ratio is defined (HGB and HCT averages exist and the HCT average is not zero). Patients with an undefined ratio are excluded from that mean and cannot pass the filter.
Patients among the kept group with no non-null PIC values have a NULL average PIC, which is ignored when averaging the average PIC values.

responses.sql: WITH p AS (SELECT ID, AVG(PIC) AS avg_pic, AVG(HGB) * 1.0 / AVG(HCT) AS ratio FROM Laboratory GROUP BY ID), o AS (SELECT AVG(ratio) AS m FROM p WHERE ratio IS NOT NULL) SELECT AVG(p.avg_pic) AS avg_of_avg_pic, AVG(p.ratio) AS avg_ratio, AVG(p.ratio - o.m) AS avg_excess FROM p CROSS JOIN o WHERE p.ratio > o.m;

assumptions.assumption: Patients whose ratio can't be computed (no non-null HGB or HCT, or an average HCT of 0) have a NULL ratio. They are left out of the all-patient average and can't pass the filter.
The all-patient average is the unweighted mean of per-patient ratios. It is not a pooled ratio over all lab rows.
A patient with no PIC values has a NULL average PIC. That patient can still be kept, and the final average of average PIC skips the NULL.
